summary: Iteration 13 FRONTEND retest of the three iteration-12 bug fixes on the Warm-ivory Admin Panel — ALL 3 PASS. (1) Extra 'index' tab is gone: bottom-tab bar now renders exactly 4 tabs with labels ['Dashboard','Orders','Products','More options'] (role='tab' count = 4). Verified by DOM query and screenshot /tmp/it13_02_dashboard.png. (2) Nested <button> hydration error on /admin/products is eliminated: 0 console messages matching 'cannot contain' / 'validateDOMNesting' across the entire authenticated session (login → products → edit → new product → publish → delete). No red 'Console Error' toast on-screen. Screenshot /tmp/it13_03_products.png. Product card is now <View> with a nested <Pressable> (cardTap) plus a sibling <Pressable data-testid='product-more-<id>'> for the more-actions icon — confirmed by inspecting /app/frontend/app/admin/products.tsx:164-211 and running DOM query which lists product-more-<id> testIDs correctly. (3) After Publish on a new product ('Retest Bowl', ₹199, stock 5), URL becomes http://localhost:3000/admin/products (NOT /admin/dashboard) and the new item appears at index 0 (top) of the list with 45 total items — verified by DOM scan and screenshot /tmp/it13_08_list.png. Long-press/tap on the new product's product-more-<id> opens the bottom sheet with Edit / Delete (screenshot /tmp/it13_09_sheet.png); tapping Delete triggers a window.confirm which is auto-accepted, and Retest Bowl is removed (still-visible=False, count back to 44). Card-body tap navigates to /admin/product/<id> edit form (screenshot /tmp/it13_04_edit.png); Publish button correctly carries testID='save-product-btn'. Regression pass: /admin/dashboard, /admin/orders, /admin/more, and /admin/order/<id> detail all render (innerText lengths 721 / 2692 / 676 respectively; order detail shows ORDER TOTAL, ORDER STATUS timeline, CUSTOMER, DELIVERY, MARK PAID sticky button). Storefront regression not re-run this iteration since no customer-facing code changed between it12 and it13 — the admin theme fixes are isolated to /app/frontend/app/admin/*. Only console noise: 7 image 404s (pre-existing, cosmetic, same as it12). No React Native red-screen errors. Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / react-native-vector-icons issues: none newly introduced.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All three iteration-12 bugs are fully closed. If retesting the admin panel again: (a) Login by mouse-clicking coordinates (195, 393) at 390x844 viewport works reliably since the 'SIGN IN' AdminButton is a role='button' <div> whose textContent is 'Sign in' (mixed case) — get_by_role(name='sign in') fails because RN-web renders it as div. Consider adding testID='login-submit-btn' to unblock future selectors. (b) Publish button on new-product form is discoverable via `[data-testid='save-product-btn']` (role=button, textContent contains an icon glyph char + 'Publish' — case-insensitive `.includes('publish')` works). (c) Bottom sheet Delete/Edit buttons are queryable via `[aria-label='Delete product']` / `[aria-label='Edit product']`. (d) The window.confirm delete dialog on web auto-accepts via `page.on('dialog', d.accept())` set before the click. (e) Product cards use testID='product-more-<uuid>' on the sibling more-actions icon (not on the card body).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all three bugs from iteration 12 are fixed. Root causes were: (1) missing `<Tabs.Screen name='index' options={{ href: null }}/>` in admin/_layout.tsx which auto-registered the /admin/index redirect route as a 5th tab, (2) nested <Pressable> inside <Pressable> on the products card which produced nested `<button role='button'>` on react-native-web and tripped React's DOM-validation warning, (3) new-product editor previously called `router.back()` regardless of edit vs create, so a create action navigated back to the dashboard (the previous screen when opened from + button). All three are addressed with minimal, targeted changes and verified working.
